ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a cuboid net composed of rectangles. In the middle there is a very long horizontal rectangular strip, divided by vertical lines into four side faces; the total horizontal length of this horizontal strip is labeled 26 cm. A rectangle is connected above the horizontal strip, and the left-side vertical label from the top edge of this upper rectangle to the bottom edge of the horizontal strip is 10 cm. Another rectangle is also connected below the horizontal strip, and the right-side vertical label from the top edge of the horizontal strip to the bottom edge of this lower rectangle is 7 cm. Reasoning: Regard the middle long horizontal strip as the four side faces of the cuboid. Let the two side lengths of the base be a and b, and the height of the box be h. The total horizontal length of the four side faces is the perimeter of the base, so 2a + 2b = 26, giving a + b = 13. From the vertical length of 10 cm in the figure, it equals the box height h plus one base side length a, so h + a = 10. From the vertical length of 7 cm in the figure, it equals the box height h plus the other base side length b, so h + b = 7. Thus a = 10 - h, b = 7 - h, substitute into a + b = 13: 10 - h + 7 - h = 13, 17 - 2h = 13, h = 2. Furthermore a = 8, b = 5. The volume is abh = 8 × 5 × 2 = 80 cm³.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows the net of a box consisting only of rectangles. How big is the volume of the box?

method.method_draft: Read the net as a rectangular prism net: the long horizontal strip is the four side faces, so its total horizontal length is the perimeter of the base, 26 cm. Let the two base side lengths be a and b, and let the box height be h. Then 2a+2b=26, so a+b=13. From the image, the vertical 10 cm measure spans the box height h plus one base side length, giving h+a=10. The vertical 7 cm measure spans the same strip height h plus the other base side length, giving h+b=7. Solve: subtracting from a+b=13 gives h=2, then a=8 and b=5. The volume is abh=8·5·2=80 cm^3.
